items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, two altos. -- and Choo Berry was the tenor. And Sam Allen was the pianist and old man Fulbright -- I forget his first name -- he was the bass player.

ctx.x: Yeah, two altos. -- and Choo Berry was the tenor. And Sam Allen was the pianist and old man Fulbright -- I forget his first name -- he was the bass player.

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Chu was there... one of the greatest things that I'll never forget with that band... Chu Berry, he was a monster with the plate... All of us was staying there. Tyree was staying there. Chu Berry and a bunch of us.

ctx.x: You see, because Brown was still there and Foots was still there and Chu was there and Jacinto Chabania.
